Name: ObjectGroupAmendId
Label: Object Group Amend ID
Description: An application generated value to uniquely identify the record. This is only available when updating an existing record.

Name: LegislativeDataGroupName
Label: Legislative Data Group Name
Description: The name of the legislative data group.

Name: ObjectCode
Label: Object Code
Description: The code of the object that is included in the group, such as the code of the element, payroll relationship, payroll assignment, element classification, element, and tax reporting unit.

Name: ObjectGroupCode
Label: Object Group Code
Description: The code of the object group for which inclusions and exclusions are being defined.

Name: ObjectGroupLevelName
Label: Object Group Level Name
Description: The name of the level at which inclusions and exclusions are defined, such as Payroll Relationship, Payroll Assignment, Element Classification, Element, and Tax Reporting Unit.

Name: IncludeOrExclude
Label: Inclusion Status
Description: Indicates if the record should be included in or excluded from the object group.

Name: LegislativeDataGroupId
Label: Legislative Data Group ID
Description: A unique reference to the legislative data group.

Name: ObjectGroupId
Label: Object Group ID
Description: A unique reference to the object group for which inclusions and exclusions are being defined.

Name: SourceSystemId
Label: Source System ID
Description: A value to uniquely identify this record. This must be unique for the source system owner and business object component.

Name: SourceSystemOwner
Label: Source System Owner
Description: The name of the source system used to generate the source system ID.

Name: GUID
Label: Globally Unique ID
Description: The globally unique ID. Only available to reference existing records, it cannot be supplied for new records.

Name: SourceRefTableName
Label: Reference Context
Description: The context for the user-defined references provided for this component. Don't supply values for this attribute, instead specify the context against this attribute in the METADATA line using the format: SourceRefTableName= context. For example: SourceRefTableName=Store Information.
